name: The Blue Grotto
riddle: When noon's light swims through the door, blue shows the way the old ones swore.

steps.objective: Swim through the arch in the cliff and surface inside the grotto.
Clear the boulder from the old ones' way out.

hints: The door is an arch low in the cliff. Inside, the noon light rises from the water: see where it goes.
Polished shells can bend light, and they turn if you grip their rims. Climb out of the water by gripping a ledge to reach them.
Light leaves a mirror at the same angle it arrives. And the old ones' way out is blocked by something only strength can shift.

reward.nextRiddle: Three ships lie still; the one with no name holds the flame.
reward.message: Map piece IV! The old ones' way out leads on to the Wreck Graveyard.
